@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+defmodule Stem.Helpers.Sanitize do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  @spec html(term()) :: String.t()
+  def html(value) do
+    value
+    |> String.Chars.to_string()
+    |> String.replace("&", "&")
+    |> String.replace("<", "<")
+    |> String.replace(">", ">")
+    |> String.replace("\"", """)
+    |> String.replace("'", "'")
+  end
+end
